concept: Questioning assumptions — including your own, not just other people's
source_inspiration: original content, informed by Socratic-method tradition — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student is asked to defend a belief they hold, and the mentor persona asks a series of genuine follow-up questions rather than arguing
exercise.branching_choice: Student's answers shape which follow-up question comes next
exercise.practice: Student notices at least one assumption underneath their own belief they hadn't stated out loud

assessment.success_marker: student identifies an unstated assumption in their own reasoning without being told what it is
